Given: a is the sum of all coefficients in 1-2x+2x220233-4x2+2x32024

⇒a=1   ...i

Now, b=limx→0∫0xlog1+tt2024+1dtx2

⇒b=limx→0log1+xx2024+12x

Also, 2bx2+ax+4=0

Let α and α be those roots.
